# `note` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "note" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/note/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | `note-<slug>`; for a book, the id of its inventory item. |
| `title` | string | required | Title on the cover (at most 40 characters, as the item's), or heading of a note or inscription (at most 60). |
| `author` | string | — | Who wrote it, in the world; required for a book, optional for the others. |
| `notes` | string | required | Author-facing: bible section it comes from, who it contradicts, what it hints. |
| `locations` | list of string (at least 1) | required | Where it can be found: one or more glossary place ids (at least one). |
| `pages` | list of object (at least 1) | required | The text, in page order; a note or inscription is usually one page. |
| `pages[].text` | string | required | The page as the reader shows it; plain text, paragraphs split by a blank line. |
| `evidence` | list of string (at least 1) | — | Evidence tags (mw-e39.23): the `evidence.*` facts that holding this text proves. Quest and dialogue conditions read the fact; the text names it so the two stay together. |
| `damaged` | boolean | `false` | True exactly when the text carries `[illegible]` or `[missing]` markers. |
